page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.large is a general-purpose KVM-based virtual machine instance powered by a dedicated 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. It features 1 physical core with hyperthreading enabled, presenting 2 vCPUs, along with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance includes 33 MB of L3 cache, support for AVX-512 vector instruction extensions including VNNI and BF16, and a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. It includes no attached local storage or GPU acceleration.

Benchmark results highlight a distinct trade-off between single-threaded clock speed and multi-threaded scaling. Single-core stress-ng tests and single-threaded compression benchmarks fall into average performance tiers, driven by the 3.3 GHz clock frequency. However, because the configuration relies on a single physical core divided across 2 vCPUs, multi-core benchmarks like PassMark CPU, Geekbench multi-core, and stress-ng multi-core demonstrate lower throughput. Memory bandwidth write speed is measured at 13.17 GB/sec, while uncached memory read speed reaches 15.65 GB/sec.

From a hardware efficiency standpoint, the ecs.hfg7.large offers a balanced vCPU-to-memory footprint for workloads that do not demand high parallel processing density or extreme memory throughput. Tasks requiring intense local storage operations or heavy database concurrency are constrained by the absence of local NVMe storage and lower memory bandwidth. Recommended workload fits include lightweight web microservices, single-threaded batch processing, utility nodes, and basic background tasks.
